title: Platform change
instructions: Tren istasyonunda kısa bir anons. Hızlı ve bilgi dolu; değişen bilgilere dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: The eleven twenty train to Oxford is now leaving from platform three, not platform six.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: This train is ten minutes late.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: There is no café on this train today.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Please do not leave your bags on the platform.

questions.evidence: The eleven twenty train to Oxford

questions.prompt: What platform does the train leave from now?
questions.feedback: Tren artık üçüncü perondan (platform three) kalkıyor, altıdan değil.
questions.evidence: now leaving from platform three, not platform six.
This train is ten minutes late.

questions.prompt: What time does the train leave now?
questions.feedback: Tren 11:20'deydi; on dakika gecikmeyle 11:30'da (eleven thirty) kalkar. İki bilgiyi birleştirmen gerek.
questions.evidence: This train is ten minutes late.

questions.prompt: What is NOT on the train today?
questions.feedback: Bugün trende kafe yok (There is no café).
questions.evidence: There is no café on this train today.
